title: Refiling State Charge: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Filing-Fee Schedule
content:
A refiling state charge is added to the refiling fee of a Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) reinstatement refiling, which replaces a certificate whose SR-26 was transmitted for a cancellation of its since-reinstated backing term. It follows the state group of the backing term's own state:

- the resident state of a Named Non-Owner Policy term;
- the garaging state of an Owner Auto Policy term.

| Backing term's own state | Refiling state charge |
|---|---|
| Florida or Virginia | 6.00 |
| Texas or Georgia | 3.00 |
| Arizona or Ohio | none |

**Questions the rule answers**

- *Which state is read for a refiling on an Owner Auto Policy term garaged in Florida but filed with Texas?* Florida, the garaging state, so 6.00.
- *A Named Non-Owner Policy term with resident state Arizona?* No refiling state charge.
